# Livenzo

> Livenzo helps students in Kota find verified rooms, PGs and hostels near top coaching centres, and helps property owners manage their renters and rent.

Livenzo lists rooms, PGs, hostels and BHK accommodation in Kota, Rajasthan. Students can search by area or landmark, filter by rent and facilities, book a free visit, and connect with the property owner. Owners can list rooms, manage renters, and collect rent.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Livenzo is and how to get started.
- [Find a room](/find-room): Search and filter rooms, PGs, hostels and BHKs in Kota.
